title: Integer to base string
description: Implement to_base(n, base). Return the string representation of integer n in the given base (2 to 36) using lowercase digits 0-9 then a-z. Negative n gets a single leading '-'. Zero is '0'. Raise ValueError if base is outside 2..36.
invariants: No leading zeros except for the value 0 itself.
Negative numbers use a leading '-' and no other sign.
Raise ValueError for base < 2 or base > 36.
